description: She wears an opaque cream floor-length gown with a low square fitted bodice, narrow shoulder straps and off-shoulder elbow-length sleeves, edged in muted gold geometric woven embroidery. A golden-brown outer wrap hangs loosely along both arms and down either side, with patterned borders and fringe. A decorated brown-and-gold belt closes with a round ornament and has long tasseled ends. A modest central walking opening reveals only lower-leg area and gold-brown closed footwear. Gold-toned earrings and a small pendant add restrained jewelry. Exact fibers are unverified; surfaces appear linen-like with richly woven outer fabric.
